integrity_notes: The theorem follows from a direct primary-factor computation and local Jordan structure; the finite-state and matrix tests are supporting checks, not a substitute for the proof. The comparison with untwisted prisms is independently derived in the result.
scientific_limitations: Binary synchronous neighbor-XOR on simple Möbius ladders with half-length n>=3; no claim about asynchronous, weighted, nonlinear or higher-characteristic dynamics. Gcd formula determines exact primitive orbit counts without an elementary expression for general maximum order. Literature equivalence outside examined sources remains a risk.
title: Möbius-ladder parity dynamics: exact transient shells and Jordan-chain fusion under a twist
